description: This is a PHP class file defining a custom exception class 'SecurityNotAllowedFilterError' within the Twig sandbox security framework. It handles errors related to disallowed filters in Twig templates.

classes.name: SecurityNotAllowedFilterError
classes.description: An exception class indicating a disallowed filter usage in Twig sandbox.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the error with a message and filter name.

methods.name: getFilterName
methods.description: Returns the name of the filter that caused the exception.
